name: lifecycle-engine
description: An AI teammate for lifecycle marketing. Describe a campaign in one sentence and get everything needed to launch it: who gets it, every message written in your email platform's own template language (Klaviyo, HubSpot, Braze, Customer.io, Salesforce Marketing Cloud), the timing, a review against email and texting law where your customers live, and a holdout that shows what the campaign truly added versus what the platform credits. It checks that your email reaches the inbox (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, sending gate), stops mailing people who never engage, writes warehouse SQL for Snowflake, BigQuery and PostgreSQL, and runs a daily health check logged to Google Sheets. It never sends a message or changes your systems without your approval.
